title: onprem/airgap: vendor RKE2 + OracleLinux 8/9 support, update offline bundle tooling
author: Priya Mehta
release_notes: Added OracleLinux (OL8/OL9) support to the on-prem airgap offline bundle; vendored updated RKE2 artifacts and TUF metadata; improved rollback tooling and apt mirror handling for airgapped installs.
body: Motivation: Customers running private/on-prem deployments requested certified offline bundles for OracleLinux (OL8 and OL9) and better handling of vendor-specific quirks when using RKE2 distributions. This PR extends the offline bundle tooling and vendoring scripts to produce air-gapped bundles for RKE2 on OL8/OL9, hardens TUF metadata handling, and updates Helm charts and Terraform modules used by the private installer. Changes include vendoring of distro-specific packages, an improved apt-mirror generation path for OL-derived images, and a rollback helper to revert TUF metadata and artifacts on installer upgrades. Checklist: - [x] Update vendor scripts to fetch OL8/OL9 packages and binaries - [x] Add RKE2 manifest variants and helm overlay for OL kernels - [x] Harden TUF metadata validation and support rollback of TUF root rotation - [x] Update Terraform module outputs and variable docs for private installer - [x] Add e2e smoke tests for airgap install on OL9 (containerized) - [x] Update on-prem private installer docs and release notes Context: This is an incremental but high-impact change required for customers using OracleLinux in regulated environments. It follows the offline bundle pattern used for RKE2/k3s/flatcar from prior PRs but adds distro-specific packaging and a safer TUF rotation/rollback path. See linked Linear ENG-1804 for acceptance criteria and test matrix. Migration notes: No API changes; upgrade path for existing bundles is compatible. Operators are advised to run the included rollback helper after any failed TUF metadata rotation attempt.
commits: feat(vendor): add oraclelinux package list and download logic
chore(vendor): normalize artifact naming for rke2-ol bundles
fix(tuf): validate multiboot metadata and fail safely on mismatch
feat(installer): add helm overlay for oraclelinux kernel taints
test(e2e): add OL9 airgap smoke test (containerized)
docs: update onprem/airgap release notes and quickstart
review_comments: Alicia Gomez: Please add a defensive check in rotate-and-verify.sh to avoid partial root rotations if artifact uploads fail.
Priya Mehta: Added an early-exit and dry-run flag; updated scripts in commit 3 (fix(tuf): validate multiboot metadata and fail safely on mismatch).
Markus Lee: The helm overlay looks good but we need explicit tolerations for OL kernels with node-labels set by downstream distros.
Priya Mehta: Added tolerations and node-label detection logic in helm/private/templates/node-pool-ol.yaml and documented behavior in values-ol.yaml.
Jordan Patel: CI flakes observed on the OL9 smoke test in the first run — looks like a timing issue with the apt mirror container startup.
Priya Mehta: Increased wait/retry logic in the test harness and added health-checks for the mirror container; reran e2e. All green.
ci_checks: security-scan: trivy on vendor artifacts — pass

Adds OL8/OL9 vendoring, TUF hardening, helm overlays, terraform outputs, and rollback helper.
